name: Button
props: variant: primary|accent|secondary|ghost|danger|split; size: sm 32|md 40|lg 48|touch 52; icon?: LucideName; iconOnly?: boolean; loading?: boolean
states: default, hover, active, focus-visible, disabled, loading (spinner + label kept)
a11y: Accent (marigold) only for the single key action per screen (Sign, Pay, Start). Icon-only buttons need aria-label + tooltip. Disabled buttons keep a visible reason nearby.

name: IconButton + Tooltip
props: icon; label (tooltip + aria-label); shortcut?
states: default, hover, focus, disabled
a11y: Tooltip on hover AND focus; shows keyboard shortcut.

name: TextField
props: label (bn · en); hint; error; required; prefix/suffix; size md 40 | touch 48 | vitals 56
states: default, hover, focus, disabled, read-only, error, loading
a11y: Label always visible (no placeholder-only labels). Error text + icon below field, linked with aria-describedby.

name: BilingualNameField
props: valueBn; valueEn; transliterate?: boolean; source chip
states: default, focus, error (either script missing), source changed
a11y: Two inputs with lang="bn" / lang="en"; source chip is a button with its own label.

name: PhoneField (+880)
props: value; owner: self|guardian|spouse|other; masks 1XXX-XXXXXX
states: default, focus, invalid operator prefix, error
a11y: inputmode="tel"; announces format.

name: DateAgeField
props: mode: dob|approx; value DD/MM/YYYY; shows y/m/d age
states: default, approximate (dashed amber + "approx." text), future date error
a11y: Approximate age is labelled in text, not just by the dashed border.

name: MoneyField (৳)
props: value; min/max; showWords: bn|en|both
states: default, focus, over limit, error
a11y: Shows amount in words live; tabular figures; South Asian grouping on blur.

name: DosePatternField
props: slots: 3|4 (morning/noon/night[/bedtime]); values 0–3 or ½; meal: before|after|with; days
states: default, focus per slot, invalid (all zero), read-only
a11y: Keyboard: digits + ← →; renders "১+০+১" per numeral setting; each slot has its own aria-label.

name: SearchField + Results
props: detects phone | name bn/en | patient no | QR; results list with highlight
states: idle, typing, loading, results, no results, error, offline (local cache badge)
a11y: Combobox pattern (aria-activedescendant); ↑↓ Enter; results announce count.
usedBy: frontDesk.search, shell command palette, consult Rx search

name: Select / MultiSelect / Chips
props: options; multiple; chips removable
states: default, open, focus, disabled, error
a11y: Native select on mobile. Chips have remove button with label.

name: Toggle / Segmented
props: options 2–5; value
states: default, hover, focus, disabled
a11y: role="radiogroup"; state conveyed by text, not colour only.

name: FileUpload + Camera
props: accept; camera: boolean; compress on slow network
states: empty, dragging, uploading (progress), queued offline, uploaded, failed-retry
a11y: Upload result carries "Uploaded — not verified" provenance.

name: DataTable
props: columns (chooser); density: comfortable 48 | compact 36; stickyHeader; stickyTotals; inlineEdit; bulkActions; pagination; filters
states: loading (skeleton rows), empty (with next action), error, partial selection, editing row
a11y: Grid role with roving tabindex; ↑↓←→ Enter to edit, Esc to cancel; row status badge = text + colour.
usedBy: billing, lab, pharmacy, admin, owner drill-down

name: PatientHeaderBanner
props: context: opd|ipd|lab|pharmacy|billing|mobile; patient {nameBn,nameEn,age,sex,patientNo,photo}; allergies[]; identity: verified|unverified|possibleDuplicate|provisional; payer; location/bed; alerts[]
states: normal, unverified identity (amber warning row), possible duplicate (warning + "Review"), no allergies recorded (explicit text), loading, restricted (permission)
a11y: Allergy strip is always visible and never collapses; red + icon + text. Identity warning uses text, never colour alone.

name: ProvenanceBadge
props: kind: verified|uploaded|patientReported|aiDraft; author; organisation; recordedAt
states: default, popover open (hover/tap/focus)
a11y: Badge has text; popover is keyboard reachable; AI draft uses dashed border + "unverified".

name: StatusPill
props: status: draft|pending|inProgress|partiallyComplete|signed|final|amended|cancelled|critical|offline|syncing|failedRetry
states: static; syncing animates icon only
a11y: Always icon + text; draft uses hatched background.

name: ResultRow
props: analyte; value; unit; refRange (age/sex aware); flag: N|H|L|HH|LL|critical; delta?; source: analyser|manual
states: normal, high, low, critical, pending, amended (shows previous value)
a11y: Flag rendered as letter + arrow icon + colour; critical adds "!!" and siren icon.

name: TimelineItem
props: type: visit|labReport|prescription|admission|document; date; facility; provenance
states: default, selected, restricted (locked row), draft
a11y: List semantics; dashed card for patient-supplied items.

name: QueueTokenCard / BedCard / WorklistCard
props: token/bed/worklist item; state; badges
states: each state carries text + icon; bed: vacant|occupied|reserved|cleaning|blocked|dischargePending
a11y: Cards are buttons or links, 44/48px min height; bed "blocked" uses hatch pattern.

name: SignOffModal
props: items that become final; confirm identity (PIN); aiReviewed checkbox when AI text present
states: idle, missing PIN, submitting, waiting for server, confirmed, failed
a11y: Lists exactly what becomes final; nothing shows "Signed" until server confirms. Focus trapped; Esc cancels.

name: ApprovalModal
props: kind: discount|concession|refund|cancel; amount; reason (required); approver
states: draft, pending, approved, rejected (needs note)
a11y: Reason required before submit; shows policy limit in text.

name: PermissionDenied / BreakGlassPanel
props: resource; reason; canRequest; breakGlass {categories, minChars:20, durationMin:60}
states: denied, request sent, break-glass form, active (countdown), ended
a11y: Explains why and who can grant. Break glass: reason + acknowledgement + PIN; persistent red banner with timer.

name: OfflineBanner / SyncIndicator / ConflictPanel
props: pendingCount; lastSync; conflicts[]
states: online, offline, syncing, failed-retry, conflict
a11y: role="status"; conflicts show both values and author, user picks.

name: Toast / InlineAlert / ConfirmDialog / Drawer / Stepper / Tabs / CommandPalette
props: standard
states: standard
a11y: Toasts never carry the only copy of an error; command palette ⌘K / Ctrl+K.

name: QRVerificationBlock
props: documentId; verifyUrl; shortCode (6 chars); size 18–24 mm
states: final (QR shown), draft (no QR, watermark)
a11y: Short code printed beside QR for manual entry; black ink only.
